title: conversations.need_changed v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the conversations module when what a conversation needs from its inbox's members opens, changes or is cleared; the attention module projects it into each member's queue. Ids, enums and a date only, never names, addresses, subjects or text. `revision` grows with every change of one conversation's need: apply only newer ones. Workspace-scoped; also listed in openapi/events.json.

need.description: The need, or null once cleared.

latest_message.description: The conversation's newest inbound message. When it changes the sender wrote again: a member's Later ends, even if the need did not change.
